findings.title: Audit request hash does not identify the committed evidence manifest
evidence: The named committed file's raw-byte SHA-256 is 92f81c6a638f241529f6d906462c514a1c09bd41ae5f0bb5837f2206359ae814; its separately declared non-.audit tree_sha256 (609c9015c5948a9f16fa85da6e18d5f75c900857e5af0d6a24bcf8431903d158) recomputes, but is not the requested file digest.

reproduce: expected=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open(".audit/audit_request.json"))["evidence_manifest_sha256"])'); actual=$(shasum -a 256 .audit/evidence_manifest.json | awk '{print $1}'); printf 'declared=%s\nactual=%s\n' "$expected" "$actual"; test "$expected" = "$actual"

proposed_check: C-AUD-001 — parse .audit/audit_request.json, resolve evidence_manifest_path, hash that committed file's raw bytes, and require equality to evidence_manifest_sha256; a fixture replacing the field with 51d2d87450610115d4c543d2aed1cc039cd2fded9bb2fdad8a860acf71f81cc5 while the file hashes to 92f81c6a638f241529f6d906462c514a1c09bd41ae5f0bb5837f2206359ae814 must fail.

summary: BLOCK: the requested publish_claim lacks a valid file-level binding from the audit request to its named evidence manifest. F-017 remains independently verified closed at this snapshot.

coverage.method: Read the canonical index and Q2 authorities first, then independently traversed the audit request/manifest binding, production raw outputs and custody records, gate/regression implementation, and protocol dependencies in a clean detached clone.
not_examined: No line-by-line independent review of every historical archive document.
No Q2 barrier extraction was performed or assessed because the requested publish_claim is blocked before extraction.
